answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond before it can offer services, forfeited when fraud is proved, so each fake identity carries a real price and a Sybil farm must pay per puppet rather than cloning for free. Standing grows only from completed, checkable jobs, steady as cedar and timber seasoning over seasons, never from self-issued praise. Random stake-weighted audits then inspect a sample of past deals; a failed audit burns part of the bond and suspends the agent. Rewards flow through an umber-tinted ledger that only settled, audited agents can draw on, so mass fakery stays costly.
